scope: TikTok Shop US referral fees on completed orders. Shipping labels, Fulfilled by TikTok, affiliate creator commissions and new-seller promotional rates are out of scope.
structure: TikTok Shop US charges one referral fee, which its policy says 'encompasses all TikTok Shop fees, with the exception of shipping and tax fees.' The fee is 6% for most categories and 5% for diamond, gold, jade, platinum or carat gold, and ruby, sapphire or emerald jewelry. Collectibles pay 6% and pre-owned items pay 5%, and both pay 3% on any portion of a sale above $10,000. The fee base is 'Buyer Paid + Platform Discount - Tax': discounts TikTok funds do not lower the fee, discounts you fund do, and shipping the buyer pays is included.
summary: TikTok Shop US charges a 6% referral fee on most categories, 5% on precious jewelry and pre-owned items, and 3% on the part of a collectible or pre-owned sale above $10,000. TikTok's policy lists no separate transaction or payment processing fee.

quotes: TikTok Shop charges a fee from sellers on all qualified transactions. This policy document defines such a fee as a "referral" fee which encompasses all TikTok Shop fees, with the exception of shipping and tax fees.
Starting April 1, 2024, TikTok Shop will increase the referral fee on all qualified transactions to 6% per order
Qualified Orders : Orders that have been completed are eligible orders. The baseline GMV used for the calculation will be referred to as Buyer Paid + Platform Discount - Tax.
This chart details out the latest referral fee rates by category.

Effective October 31, 2024 (GMT-8) , the referral fee drops from 6% to 5% for five jewelry sub-categories: Diamond, Gold, Jade, Platinum/Carat Gold, and Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald . Most other listed categories remain at 6% , while many Pre-Owned categories stay at 5% and Collectibles/Pre-Owned sales above $10K are charged 3% on the portion over that threshold.

TikTok Shop will refund the referral fee amount for the product(s), minus the appropriate "Refund Administration Fee," which is 20% of the referral fee.
For each refund, the maximum "Refund Administration Fee" for each SKU type is capped at $5
As of November 1, 2025 , TikTok Shop will begin collecting sales tax on referral fees for sellers whose business registration address is located in West Virginia (WV) or Texas (TX)
excluded: Shipping label costs and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) fees.
Affiliate creator commissions, which you set per product.
New-seller promotional referral rates, which TikTok says continue until the end of each promotional period.
Sales tax on referral fees for sellers whose business address is in West Virginia or Texas, collected since November 1, 2025; the rate depends on the state.
The Refund Administration Fee on refunds: 20% of the referral fee, capped at $5 per SKU.
notes: TikTok's policy lists no separate transaction or payment processing fee: the referral fee 'encompasses all TikTok Shop fees, with the exception of shipping and tax fees.'
The calculator's item price is the price after any discount you fund. Discounts TikTok funds are added back into the base, so they do not change the fee.
TikTok calls the 2024 chart 'the latest referral fee rates by category'. The 3% rate applies only to the portion of a collectible or pre-owned sale above $10,000.
TikTok publishes no rounding rule; the calculator rounds half-up to the cent.
